verdict.rationale: Jules exposes a public API for creating tasks, sending messages, and enabling automation (PR creation) — core building blocks of the UI workflow — and a community user confirms dispatching tasks via the API from an external MCP client, showing real usage beyond the UI. However, there's no documented API coverage for plan approval, diff browsing/approval, or settings/API-key management, and no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (probes 404), so full UI/API parity is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: API endpoints for plan review/approval, diff/PR review parity, settings management, and a public API spec confirming full feature coverage.
